subject: Hormel Stadium Turf Replacement
overview: The commission reviewed finances, approved past minutes, and discussed project planning and procurement for the upcoming $1 million Hormel Stadium turf replacement.

items.title: Permit and Use Applications
items.summary: The commission noted that no new permit applications or facility requests were submitted for review.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the August 12 meeting minutes with an edit clarifying that replacing the scoreboard panel is cheaper than replacing the lights.

items.title: Finance Report
items.summary: Accepted the finance report after reviewing a temporary paper deficit caused by pending account rollovers and noting incoming rental revenue from the Boston Ski & Sports Club.

items.title: Turf Replacement Update
items.summary: Staff reported that City Council approved the $1 million appropriation for turf replacement, and outlined next steps to hire an engineering firm for subsurface assessments, target a July construction period, and determine sport lining configurations.

items.title: Next Meeting Scheduling
items.summary: Scheduled the November meeting for November 4 to avoid the Veterans Day holiday.
